descriptionChirho: Hanan (חָנָן) — a proper name borne by several individuals in the Hebrew Bible, including: a Benjaminite descendant (1 Chr 8:23), a son of Azel (1 Chr 8:38; 9:44), a son of Maakah among David's warriors (1 Chr 11:43), a family head returning from exile (Ezra 2:46; Neh 7:49), Levites assisting Ezra (Neh 8:7; 10:10,22,26), and a son of Igdaliah with a chamber in the Temple (Jer 35:4). English 'Hanan/Chanan/and Chanan,' Spanish 'Hanán/Janán/y Janán,' Hindi हानान/और हानान, Arabic حانان/وحانان, Korean 하난/그리고 하난, Swahili Hanani/na Hanani. The two clusters differ only by the conjunction waw prefix.
